description: This file defines the LeavePeriodAPI class, which provides API endpoints for managing leave periods within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving current and all leave periods, updating leave periods, and associated validation rules.

classes.name: LeavePeriodAPI
classes.description: API class for managing leave periods, including retrieving current and all leave periods, updating leave period details, and associated validation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the current leave period history and whether it is defined.

methods.name: getCurrentLeavePeriod
methods.description: Returns the normalized current leave period data if defined, otherwise null.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getOne' endpoint, excluding ID parameter.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all leave periods, including the current leave period and whether it's defined.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' endpoint, which are none.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the leave period with provided start month and day, saves it, and optionally enables the leave menu in the UI.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating the leave period, including valid months and days.

methods.description: Method not implemented; throws not implemented exception.

methods.description: Method not implemented; throws not implemented exception.
